title: The Fourth, 2009 · before
logline: The day before, three weeks married: Maria in the shack under the eave looking at the lawn chair folded there, the uncle's chair, and Gully saying it was his uncle's, and Maria saying she knows whose it was. She unfolds it. Wood on the steps.

panels.composition: Under the eave: a folded lawn chair. MARIA looking at it. GULLY beside her.
